name: lint-runtime-globals
goal: Recognize the supported structuredClone runtime global in root TypeScript lint while preserving all other lint checks.

evidence: Root lint reports structuredClone as undefined even though the pinned Node and Bun runtimes provide it. Reproduce with eslint on the committed worker claim fixture.

The existing worker claim fixture uses structuredClone in four states; the normal root ESLint check incorrectly flags all four. Configuration behavior is verified by lint itself rather than a new runtime test.
